1. What this app is
Summer TV is a free, open-source player (AGPL-3.0) based on TVBox. It only provides playback, search aggregation and configuration management. It does not produce, store, upload or distribute any video or live content, and charges no fees. Anyone selling this app is not affiliated with this project.

2. Content sources
All on-demand, live and parsing content shown in the app comes from third-party public addresses operated independently by third parties. This project does not control, review or endorse them, and makes no guarantee of their legality, accuracy, completeness or availability. Copyright belongs to the original rights holders.

3. Your responsibility
Follow the laws of your region. Use this app only for personal study and research, not for commercial purposes or for spreading infringing or illegal material. You bear all risks and legal liability arising from accessing, playing or downloading third-party content.

4. Infringement notices
Rights holders should first contact the relevant content provider. If a built-in configuration address is involved, open an issue at github.com/10000ge10000/Summer-Tv and the address will be removed after verification.

5. Third-party ads
Some third-party content may contain embedded ads (such as captions or watermarks in the video). They are not related to this project; do not trust gambling, investment or dating offers in them.

6. Data and privacy
Anonymous analytics is on by default and only sends app version, channel, device type, playback scene and a random install ID, never source URLs or search terms. You can turn it off any time under About - Anonymous analytics. The home screen requests Douban public endpoints, and update checks contact GitHub and its mirrors. Everything else stays on this device.

7. Disclaimer of liability
This app is provided as is, without any guarantee of uninterrupted or error-free service or of third-party content availability. To the extent permitted by law, the project and its developers are not liable for any direct or indirect loss arising from using or being unable to use this app or third-party content.

8. Minors
Users under 18 should use this app with the consent and supervision of a guardian.
